source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 7 (PDF 93-106), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Hypothesis Testing) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 In this chapter, research questions are converted into:
(Is chapter mein research questions (tehqeeqi sawal) ko kis cheez mein badla jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Introduction ke mutabiq research questions ko testable hypotheses (jaanch ke qabil mafrooze) mein badla jata hai.

book_ref.quote: how research questions are converted into testable hypotheses

blocks.prompt:
2 According to the learning outcomes, findings are communicated using advanced data visuals and then:
(Learning outcomes ke mutabiq findings (nataij) advanced data visuals se batane ke baad kya kiya jata hai?)

options.text: dataset se mita diya jata hai
unhein wapas hypotheses se jora jata hai

blocks.explanation: Doosra learning outcome: findings ko advanced visuals se batana aur unhein wapas hypotheses se jorna.

book_ref.quote: tie them back to hypotheses

blocks.prompt:
3 Hypothesis testing is best described as a method that:
(Hypothesis testing (mafroze ki jaanch) ko behtareen tor par kaise bayan kiya jata hai?)

options.text: data ki madad se faisle karta hai
data ko database mein rakhta hai
internet se data jama karta hai

blocks.explanation: 7.1: hypothesis testing data ki madad se faisle karne ka tareeqa hai; yeh check karta hai ke koi mafroza sahi hai ya ghalat.

book_ref.quote: Hypothesis testing is a method used to make decisions using data.

blocks.prompt:
4 Hypothesis testing reduces guesswork because it:
(Hypothesis testing andaze (guesswork) ko kyun kam karta hai?)

options.text: sirf zaati raaye istemal karta hai
data jama karne se bachta hai
saboot par mabni (evidence-based) faislon ki himayat karta hai

blocks.explanation: Kitab ke mutabiq yeh tareeqa saboot par mabni (evidence-based) faislon ki himayat karta hai, is liye andaza kam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This method reduces guesswork as it supports evidence-based decisions.

blocks.prompt:
5 According to the Tidbit of Section 7.1, the results of hypothesis testing depend on:
(7.1 ke Tidbit ke mutabiq hypothesis testing ke nataij kis par munhasar hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tidbit ke aakhir mein hai: nataij durust testing par munhasar hain.

book_ref.quote: Results depend on proper testing.

blocks.prompt:
6 When is a hypothesis made in research?
(Research mein hypothesis kab banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hypothesis aik mafroza ya bayan hai jo testing shuru hone se pehle banaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: A hypothesis is an assumption or statement in research that is made before testing begins.

blocks.prompt:
7 Because a hypothesis predicts an outcome, it must be:
(Kyunke hypothesis kisi nateeje ki peshgoi (prediction) karta hai, is liye use kaisa hona chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Hypothesis nateeje ki peshgoi karta hai, is liye use wazeh aur naapne ke qabil (measurable) hona chahiye.

book_ref.quote: A hypothesis predicts an outcome; therefore, must be clear and measurable.

blocks.prompt:
8 In the hypothesis function hθ(x) = y, the symbol θ stands for:
(Hypothesis function hθ(x) = y mein θ kis cheez ki alamat hai?)
blocks.explanation: θ model ke parameters ya weights (wazan) hain, jaise linear regression ke coefficients; x input hai aur y predicted output.

book_ref.quote: The hypothesis function with parameters (θ) applied to input (x).

blocks.prompt:
9 In hθ(x) = y, the letter y represents:
(hθ(x) = y mein y kya zahir karta hai?)

options.text: predicted output ya target value (matloob qeemat)

blocks.explanation: y predicted output ya target value hai, yani diye gaye input ke liye model ki peshgoi.

book_ref.quote: The predicted output or target value

blocks.prompt:
10 In the hypothesis function hθ(x) = y, x stands for:
(Hypothesis function hθ(x) = y mein x kis cheez ke liye hai?)
blocks.explanation: x input features ya data points hain, maslan dataset ki attributes (khasusiyat).

book_ref.quote: The input features or data points

blocks.prompt:
11 What is defined by a research question?
(Research question kya tay karta hai?)

options.text: Kya cheez study ki ja rahi hai

blocks.explanation: Research question batata hai ke kya parha/jaancha ja raha hai; hypothesis usi sawal se banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Research questions define what is being studied.

blocks.prompt:
12 A hypothesis is formed from:
(Hypothesis kis cheez se banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab: hypothesis research question se banta hai; hypotheses mumkina jawab dete hain.

book_ref.quote: A hypothesis is formed from the research question.

blocks.prompt:
13 Which statement about research questions and hypotheses is correct?
(Research questions aur hypotheses ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Sawal data collection ki rehnumai karte hain aur hypotheses mumkina jawab dete hain
Hypotheses data collection ki rehnumai aur sawal jawab dete hain
Dono ka aapas mein koi talluq nahin
Sawal conclusion ke baad likhe jate hain

blocks.explanation: Sawal data jama karne ki rehnumai karte hain; hypotheses mumkina jawab dete hain; dono gehra talluq rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Hypotheses provide possible answers.

blocks.prompt:
14 According to the book, good research starts with:
(Kitab ke mutabiq achhi research kis se shuru hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Achhi research achhe sawalon se shuru hoti hai; wazeh sawal wazeh hypotheses dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Good research starts with good questions.

blocks.text: Role of Hypothesis Testing in Data Analysis

blocks.prompt:
15 One role of hypothesis testing in data analysis is that it:
(Data analysis mein hypothesis testing ka aik kirdar kya hai?)

options.text: data ki zaroorat khatam karta hai

blocks.explanation: Hypothesis testing data ko mantiqi tor par parakhta hai; testing be-tarteeb (random) nataij se bachati hai.

book_ref.quote: Testing avoids random conclusions.

blocks.prompt:
16 Hypothesis testing supports accuracy and is used in:
(Hypothesis testing accuracy (durusti) ki himayat karta hai aur kahan istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab: hypothesis testing durusti ki himayat karta hai aur experiments aur surveys mein istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: which is used in experiments and surveys

blocks.prompt:
17 Since decisions in hypothesis testing are based on evidence, the method:
(Kyunke hypothesis testing mein faisle saboot par hote hain, is liye yeh tareeqa:)

options.text: nataij ko kam qabil-e-aitmaad banata hai
data collection ki jagah le leta hai
analysis ki zaroorat khatam karta hai

blocks.explanation: Faisle saboot par hote hain; yeh tareeqa nataij par aitmaad barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: This method improves confidence in results.

blocks.prompt:
18 The two most common types of hypotheses are:
(Hypotheses ki do sab se aam qismein kaun si hain?)
blocks.explanation: 7.2: sab se aam qismein null aur alternative hypotheses hain; dono testing mein mil kar kaam karti hain.

book_ref.quote: The most common types are null and alternative hypotheses.

blocks.prompt:
19 Correct hypotheses improve the quality of analysis by:
(Durust hypotheses analysis ka maiyar kaise behtar karte hain?)

options.text: data ki zaroorat khatam kar ke

blocks.explanation: Durust hypotheses uljhan (confusion) kam kar ke analysis ka maiyar behtar karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Correct hypotheses improve analysis quality by reducing confusion.

blocks.prompt:
20 The null hypothesis is written as:
(Null hypothesis kis tor par likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Null hypothesis kehta hai ke koi asar ya farq nahin; yeh default (pehle se maana hua) mafroza hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It is written as a default assumption.

blocks.prompt:
21 When is the null hypothesis rejected?
(Null hypothesis kab reject (radd) kiya jata hai?)

options.text: Jab is ke khilaf saboot mazboot ho
Jab koi data jama na ho

blocks.explanation: Data ko null hypothesis ke khilaf parakha jata hai; agar saboot mazboot ho to use radd kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: If evidence is strong, the null hypothesis is rejected.

blocks.prompt:
22 Which is a use of the null hypothesis stated in the book?
(Kitab mein null hypothesis ka kaun sa faida bataya gaya hai?)

options.text: Significance level ki jagah leta hai
Bias se bachata hai aur muqable ki bunyad (comparison base) deta hai

blocks.explanation: Null hypothesis bias (tarafdari) se bachata hai aur muqable ki bunyad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The null hypothesis helps avoid bias.

blocks.prompt:
23 The alternative hypothesis states that:
(Alternative hypothesis kya kehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alternative hypothesis kehta hai ke asar ya farq maujood hai; yeh null hypothesis ka ulat hai.

book_ref.quote: The alternative hypothesis states that there is an effect or difference.

blocks.prompt:
24 The alternative hypothesis is represented by:
(Alternative hypothesis ki alamat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alternative hypothesis H₁ ya Ha se likha jata hai; H₀ null hypothesis hai aur α significance level.

book_ref.quote: It is represented by H₁ or Ha.

blocks.prompt:
25 To accept the alternative hypothesis, the evidence must be:
(Alternative hypothesis qubool karne ke liye saboot kaisa hona chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Testing ka maqsad aksar H₁ ki himayat hota hai, aur use qubool karne ke liye saboot mazboot hona chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Evidence must be strong to accept it.

blocks.prompt:
26 For the research question 'Does the amount of study time affect students' exam scores?', the null hypothesis is:
(Research question 'Kya parhai ka waqt students ke exam scores par asar daalta hai?' ke liye null hypothesis kya hai?)

options.text: Parhai ka waqt scores par numayan asar daalta hai
Exam scores parhai ka waqt tay karte hain
Zyada parhne wale hamesha fail hote hain
Parhai ke waqt aur exam scores mein koi numayan talluq nahin

blocks.explanation: Kitab ki misal mein H₀ kehta hai ke koi numayan talluq nahin; H₁ kehta hai ke parhai ka waqt scores par asar daalta hai.

book_ref.quote: There is no significant relationship between study time and exam scores.

blocks.prompt:
27 Which hypothesis represents change or impact?
(Kaun sa hypothesis tabdeeli ya asar (impact) ko zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alternative hypothesis tabdeeli ya asar zahir karta hai aur research ki simt batata hai.

book_ref.quote: It represents change or impact.

blocks.prompt:
28 Which is a property of a correctly formulated hypothesis?
(Durust tareeqe se banaye gaye hypothesis ki khasoosiyat kya hai?)

options.text: Wazeh, makhsoos (specific) aur data se testable
Data se test nahin ho sakta
Research question se mel nahin khata

blocks.explanation: Durust hypothesis wazeh, makhsoos aur data se testable hona chahiye; mubham bayan durusti kam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Correct hypotheses must be clear and specific.

blocks.prompt:
29 Vague statements in a hypothesis:
(Hypothesis mein mubham (vague) bayanat ka kya asar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab: mubham bayanat durusti (accuracy) kam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Vague statements reduce accuracy.

blocks.prompt:
30 Which benefit of correct formulation of hypotheses is given in the book?
(Hypotheses ko durust banane ka kaun sa faida kitab mein diya gaya hai?)

options.text: Data jama karna ghair zaroori bana deta hai
Null hypothesis ko sach sabit kar deta hai
Waqt bachata hai aur qabil-e-aitmaad nataij deta hai

blocks.explanation: Durust formulation waqt bachata hai aur qabil-e-aitmaad nataij deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Correct formulation saves time.

blocks.prompt:
31 While formulating a hypothesis, variables should be:
(Hypothesis banate waqt variables kaise hone chahiyein?)

options.text: wazeh tor par bayan kiye jayen
test ke baad badal diye jayen

blocks.explanation: Hypothesis research question se mel khaye aur variables (badalne wali cheezein) wazeh tor par bayan hon.

book_ref.quote: Variables should be defined clearly.

blocks.prompt:
32 The concepts of hypothesis testing (Section 7.3) mainly guide:
(Hypothesis testing ke concepts (7.3) zyada tar kis cheez ki rehnumai karte hain?)

options.text: hypotheses ko qubool ya radd karne ki

blocks.explanation: Har concept ka khaas kirdar hai; yeh hypotheses ko qubool ya radd karne ki rehnumai karte hain.

book_ref.quote: They guide acceptance or rejection of hypotheses.

blocks.prompt:
33 Test statistics are numerical values that:
(Test statistics aisi adadi qeematein hain jo:)

options.text: sample data se nikalti hain aur data ke rawayye ka khulasa deti hain
data jama karne se pehle chuni jati hain
sirf population se li jati hain

blocks.explanation: Test statistics sample data se nikali gayi adadi qeematein hain jo data ke rawayye ka khulasa deti hain.

book_ref.quote: These values summarize data behavior.

blocks.prompt:
34 A test statistic shows:
(Test statistic kya dikhata hai?)

options.text: nataij tawaqqo se kitne door hain

blocks.explanation: Test statistics dikhate hain ke nataij tawaqqo se kitne door hain.

book_ref.quote: They show how far results are from expectations.

blocks.prompt:
35 In the t-value formula t = (x̄ − μ₀) / (s/√n), μ₀ is:
(t-value formula t = (x̄ − μ₀) / (s/√n) mein μ₀ kya hai?)

options.text: null hypothesis ke tehat population mean (ausat)

blocks.explanation: x̄ sample mean, μ₀ null hypothesis ke tehat population mean, s sample standard deviation aur n sample size hai.

book_ref.quote: Population mean under the null hypothesis

blocks.prompt:
36 A sample of 25 students has mean 62, sample standard deviation 5, and the population mean under H₀ is 60. The t-value is:
(25 students ke sample ka mean 62, sample standard deviation 5 aur H₀ ke tehat population mean 60 hai. t-value kya hogi?)
blocks.explanation: t = (62 − 60)/(5/√25) = 2/1 = 2.0 (kitab wali misal ka tareeqa, qeematein badli hui).

book_ref.quote: Suppose we have a sample of 25 students with an average score of 80

blocks.prompt:
37 A sample of 16 has mean 45 and standard deviation 8; μ₀ = 42. What is t?
(16 ke sample ka mean 45 aur standard deviation 8 hai; μ₀ = 42. t kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: s: Sample standard deviation

blocks.prompt:
38 In the chi-square formula χ² = Σ (Oᵢ − Eᵢ)² / Eᵢ, Eᵢ stands for:
(Chi-square formula χ² = Σ (Oᵢ − Eᵢ)² / Eᵢ mein Eᵢ kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oᵢ har category ki observed (dekhi gayi) frequency aur Eᵢ expected (mutawaqqa) frequency hai.

book_ref.quote: Expected frequency in each category

blocks.prompt:
39 A fair die is rolled 60 times. What is the expected frequency of each face?
(Aik fair (munsifana) dice 60 baar phenka jata hai. Har face ki expected frequency kitni hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Fair dice ke 6 barabar imkaan wale face hain, is liye har face ki expected frequency 60/6 = 10, jaise kitab ke table mein.

book_ref.quote: Suppose you roll a fair die 60 times and observe the following frequencies:

blocks.prompt:
40 Why do different tests give different test statistics such as t-value and chi-square value?
(Mukhtalif tests mukhtalif test statistics (jaise t-value aur chi-square value) kyun dete hain?)

options.text: Kyunke har test aik hi formula istemal karta hai
Kyunke mukhtalif tests mukhtalif statistics istemal karte hain
Kyunke test statistics nikale hi nahin jate
Kyunke sirf charts istemal hote hain

blocks.explanation: Kitab: mukhtalif tests mukhtalif statistics istemal karte hain; misalein t-value aur chi-square value.

book_ref.quote: Examples include t-value and chi-square value.

blocks.prompt:
41 When is the critical region defined?
(Critical region kab tay kiya jata hai?)

options.text: Sirf jab null hypothesis qubool ho

blocks.explanation: Critical region qeematon ki aik range hai jo testing se pehle tay ki jati hai.

book_ref.quote: It is defined before testing.

blocks.prompt:
42 The size of the critical region depends on:
(Critical region kis cheez par munhasar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Critical region significance level par munhasar hai aur intehai nataij dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: The region depends on the significance level.

blocks.prompt:
43 The critical region shows:
(Critical region kya dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Critical region intehai (extreme) nataij dikhata hai; test statistic is mein gire to H₀ radd hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It shows extreme outcomes.

blocks.prompt:
44 Critical regions are often shown using:
(Critical regions aksar kis cheez se dikhaye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab: graphs aksar critical regions dikhate hain.

book_ref.quote: Graphs often show critical regions.

blocks.prompt:
45 The significance level is written as:
(Significance level kis alamat se likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Significance level alpha (α) se likha jata hai; aam qeemat 0.05 hai.

book_ref.quote: The significance level shows risk of error. It is written as alpha.

blocks.prompt:
46 If the significance level is lowered from 0.05 to 0.01, the test becomes:
(Agar significance level 0.05 se 0.01 kar diya jaye to test kaisa ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Significance level batata hai test kitna sakht hai; kam qeemat ka matlab zyada sakht testing.

book_ref.quote: Lower values mean stricter testing.

blocks.prompt:
47 When is the significance level chosen?
(Significance level kab chuna jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Significance level analysis se pehle chuna jata hai; durust intikhab aitmaad barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: It is chosen before analysis.

blocks.prompt:
48 Which statement about the significance level is correct?
(Significance level ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Sample mean se nikala jata hai
Ghalat nataij ko qaboo karta hai aur faisle par asar daalta hai

blocks.explanation: Significance level ghalti ka khatra dikhata hai, ghalat nataij ko qaboo karta hai aur faisle par asar daalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Significance level controls false results and affects decision-making.

blocks.prompt:
49 The p-value shows the strength of evidence:
(p-value kis ke khilaf saboot ki taqat dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: p-value null hypothesis ke khilaf saboot ki taqat dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: The p-value shows the strength of evidence against the null hypothesis.

blocks.prompt:
50 A small p-value supports rejection of the null hypothesis because it suggests the result:
(Chhota p-value null hypothesis ke radd ki himayat kyun karta hai? Kyunke yeh batata hai ke nateeja:)

options.text: ittefaq (chance) se aane ka imkaan kam hai

blocks.explanation: Chhota p-value batata hai ke nateeja ittefaq (chance) se aane ka imkaan kam hai, is liye H₀ radd karne ki himayat hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: it suggests that the result is unlikely to have occurred by chance

blocks.prompt:
51 A researcher uses α = 0.05 and obtains p = 0.08. The correct decision is:
(Researcher α = 0.05 leta hai aur p = 0.08 aata hai. Durust faisla kya hai?)

options.text: Null hypothesis ko radd nahin karna (fail to reject)
p dekh kar α ko 0.10 kar dena

blocks.explanation: p-value ko α se milaya jata hai. Yahan 0.08 > 0.05, is liye saboot kafi nahin aur H₀ radd nahin hota (kitab ki 0.03 < 0.05 wali misal ke baraks).

book_ref.quote: After analysing the test scores, the p-value is found to be (0.03).

blocks.prompt:
52 In the book's medicine example, a p-value of 0.01 means that the new drug's improvement is:
(Kitab ki dawai wali misal mein p-value 0.01 ka matlab hai ke nayi dawai ki behtari:)

options.text: sirf ittefaq ki wajah se hone ka imkaan kam hai

blocks.explanation: p-value 0.01 mazboot saboot deta hai ke behtari sirf ittefaq ki wajah se hone ka imkaan kam hai.

book_ref.quote: If the p-value is (0.01), it gives strong evidence

blocks.prompt:
53 Which p-value gives the STRONGEST evidence against the null hypothesis?
(Kaun sa p-value null hypothesis ke khilaf SAB SE mazboot saboot deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jitna chhota p-value, utna mazboot saboot H₀ ke khilaf; yahan 0.01 sab se chhota hai.

book_ref.quote: A clear understanding of p-values helps avoid mistakes

blocks.prompt:
54 The process of performing a hypothesis test (Figure 7.1) starts with:
(Hypothesis test karne ka amal (Figure 7.1) kis se shuru hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amal hypotheses define karne se shuru hota hai; phir data, test statistics, muqabla aur faisla.

book_ref.quote: The process starts with defining hypotheses.

blocks.prompt:
55 Following proper steps in hypothesis testing:
(Hypothesis testing mein durust steps par amal karne se:)

options.text: data ki zaroorat khatam ho jati hai
ghaltiyan kam hoti hain aur munsifana testing hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Durust steps ghaltiyan kam karte hain aur munsifana testing yaqeeni banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Proper steps reduce errors.

blocks.prompt:
56 Which step comes immediately after defining the null and alternative hypotheses?
(Null aur alternative hypotheses define karne ke foran baad kaun sa step aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Steps: H₀ aur H₁; significance level chunna; data jama karna; test statistics; p-value; α se muqabla; faisla.

book_ref.quote: Next, a significance level is selected.

blocks.prompt:
57 In the steps of hypothesis testing, the p-value is compared with:
(Hypothesis testing ke steps mein p-value ko kis se milaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: p-value milne ke baad nataij ko significance level se milaya jata hai aur faisla hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Results are compared with the significance level.

blocks.prompt:
58 Which is the correct order of these three steps?
(In teen steps ki durust tarteeb kya hai?)

options.text: Data jama karna, test statistics nikalna, p-value nikalna
p-value, data jama karna, test statistics
Test statistics, data jama karna, p-value
p-value, test statistics, data jama karna

blocks.explanation: Pehle samples se data jama hota hai; phir test statistics; phir p-value.

book_ref.quote: Data is collected from samples.

blocks.prompt:
59 Which pair are the simple hypothesis-testing examples named in the book?
(Kitab mein hypothesis testing ki kaun si do aasan misalein di gayi hain?)

options.text: Exam results ki testing aur ausat qad (height) check karna
List sort aur tree search karna

blocks.explanation: Aik misal exam results ki testing, doosri ausat qad (height) check karna; data samples se liya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Another example is checking average height.

blocks.prompt:
60 Why are simple examples used to learn hypothesis testing?
(Hypothesis testing seekhne ke liye aasan misalein kyun di jati hain?)

options.text: Asal data ki jagah leti hain
Hamesha null hypothesis radd karti hain
Aitmaad barhati hain aur concept aasani se samjhati hain

blocks.explanation: Aasan misalein aitmaad barhati hain aur concept aasani se samjhati hain.

book_ref.quote: Simple examples build confidence.

blocks.text: Advanced Tests: F-Test and Chi-Square Test

blocks.prompt:
61 The F-test compares:
(F-test kis cheez ka muqabla karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: F-test variances (phailao ke paimane) ka muqabla karta hai aur analysis of variance mein istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The F-test compares variances.

blocks.prompt:
62 The Chi-Square test is used with:
(Chi-Square test kis qisam ke data ke saath istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chi-Square test talluqat check karta hai aur categorical (qismon wale) data ke saath istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It is used with categorical data.

blocks.prompt:
63 The test used in analysis of variance is the:
(Analysis of variance mein kaun sa test istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: F-test variances milata hai; yeh analysis of variance mein istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It is used in analysis of variance.

blocks.prompt:
64 Sample 1 has variance 25 and sample 2 has variance 16. Using F = S₁²/S₂², F is about:
(Sample 1 ka variance 25 aur sample 2 ka 16 hai. F = S₁²/S₂² se F taqreeban kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: F = 25/16 = 1.5625 ≈ 1.56 (kitab ka tareeqa, qeematein badli hui).

book_ref.quote: S₁² = Variance of sample1

blocks.prompt:
65 After the F-value is calculated, it is compared with:
(F-value nikalne ke baad use kis se milaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: F-value ko F-table ki critical value se milaya jata hai taake pata chale ke variances mein numayan farq hai ya nahin.

book_ref.quote: is compared with a critical value from the F-table

blocks.prompt:
66 In the book's worked example on a new teaching method, the null hypothesis is:
(Kitab ki naye teaching method wali misal mein null hypothesis kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pichhla ausat 70 tha, is liye H₀: naya method marks nahin barhata (μ = 70); H₁: μ > 70.

book_ref.quote: The previous average marks were 70.

blocks.prompt:
67 In the worked example (10 students), the degrees of freedom are:
(Hal shuda misal (10 students) mein degrees of freedom kitne hain?)

book_ref.quote: A sample of 10 students taught with the new method obtained the following marks:

blocks.prompt:
